payload.title: Local candidate survey and benchmark harness
payload.description: Benchmark at least 3 small offline candidates on this M1: Cardiff twitter-roberta (task 1), onnx-community/twitter-xlm-roberta-base-sentiment-ONNX (XLM-T multilingual), SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions-onnx with a documented 28-emotion to pos/neu/neg mapping; survey Ollama/llama.cpp zero-shot without installing (neither runtime is present; note install size).
